description: Ask an analyst-shaped question over a fresh scan of a niche (Pro): 'the biggest developments this week', 'what is emerging', 'where money is moving'. Returns the sourced slate plus a short synthesis when requested. Returns a session_id; poll niche_session_state until cp1_awaiting_story. For synthesis, continue polling with wait_until=synthesis and wait=30 until it arrives or a shortfall is reported.

count.description: Requested number of developments, from 3 to 15. The result can contain fewer when reporting is limited.

idempotency_key.description: Optional stable key for retries of the same scan, so a retry reuses the original run.

lens.description: mainstream covers established reporting, emerging emphasizes newer topics, and investment focuses on funding developments.

recency_strict.description: Exclude reporting outside the requested window. Default false; strict windows can return fewer stories.

source_quality.description: strict prioritizes well-supported stories; balanced is the default; broad includes less-established reporting. Inspect the returned sources before relying on a claim.

subject.description: The subject/space to investigate (2-200 chars). Specific is better.

synthesis.description: none returns stories only. narratives adds sourced themes across the stories. patterns adds a summary of broader developments. Default none.

window.description: Reporting window: 24h, week, month, quarter, or year. Pair with recency_strict for a hard cutoff.
